name: SIQ - Polaroid Wall
description: Playful polaroid-style collection cards scattered on a wall with random tilts, tape decorations, and handwritten-style labels. Each card has a thick white border, subtle drop shadow, and reveals a color tint on hover. Configurable rotation range, card sizing, background texture, and staggered entrance animations. Perfect for lifestyle, artisan, and creative brands.
author: SectionIQ
